implementation: Pool.deliver_callback resolves stable scratch tokens, runs native unbound callback routing, preserves deferred disposal and reports missing cookies.
regression: End, repeated End, marker, swap-last cleanup, stale cookie after cleanup; surviving source remains untouched.
limits: Core callback routing only; physical device callback producer still to connect.
No normal client rebuilt or audible runtime validation.
Caller must provide a stable unique cookie for each live scratch allocation.
